lede: Digital marketing training for professionals responsible for an organization’s online presence covers audience research, channel planning and campaign measurement. Learners explore content and social media marketing, SEO, paid search, email and website optimization, then develop digital strategies with budgets, KPIs and reporting to assess performance.
audienceIntro: This course is meticulously crafted for professionals seeking to excel in digital marketing roles.
modules: Module 5 Paid Search (PPC) Using Google Ads
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have basic knowledge of digital marketing principles and practices. Familiarity with online tools and platforms is beneficial.
